[ 3 ] At the 2014 Wimbledon Championships , she became the first player representing Canada [ a ] to reach the final of a major singles tournament, finishing runner-up to Petra Kvitová . [ 4 ] Bouchard also reached the semifinals of the 2014 Australian Open [ 5 ] and 2014 French Open . [ 6 ] Having won the 2012 Wimbledon girls' title as a junior, [ 7 ] she was named WTA Newcomer of the Year at the end of the 2013 WTA Tour . [ 8 ] [ 9 ] She received the WTA Most Improved Player award for the 2014 season and reached a career-high ranking of world No. 5, becoming the first Canadian tennis player to be ranked in the top 5 in singles.
